titles.native: カードファイト!! ヴァンガード will+Dress Season3

description:
The third season of Cardfight!! Vanguard: will+Dress.

Vanguard becomes dominated by the Uniformers. A world where everyone can become the strongest... Is the world envisioned by AI GUI ideal? Yu-yu and his friends fight for the sake of enjoyable cardfights with individuality!
